nodes.description: symbol public string of PapaMusk token, set to MUSK in constructor
name public string of PapaMusk token, set to Papa Musk in constructor
decimals public uint8, set to 18 in constructor
_totalSupply public uint holding initial 28061971 token units
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances
owner public address in Owned, current privileged account
newOwner public address in Owned, pending ownership handoff target
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure addition with overflow require
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure subtraction with underflow require
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure multiplication with overflow require
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure division with zero-divisor require
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner, sets pending newOwner
acceptOwnership() completing two-step ownership transfer when msg.sender == newOwner
PapaMusk constructor initialising metadata, supply and initial balance
totalSupply() constant returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returning balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moving tokens from msg.sender to to
approve(address spender, uint tokens) setting allowance from msg.sender
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) consuming allowance and moving balances
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returning allowed entry
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) setting allowance then calling spender.receiveApproval
payable fallback function that always reverts, rejecting ETH

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into newOwner/owner state during the Owned construction and ownership flow
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is reassigned
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner completing the handoff
onlyOwner reads owner state to authorize transferOwnership
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by msg.sender
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using caller identity
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner
constructor assigns symbol state variable
constructor assigns _totalSupply state variable
constructor credits the initial deployer balance in balances
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit
approve writes the allowed mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit
allowance reads the allowed mapping
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call
totalSupply reads _totalSupply state variable
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] state variable
totalSupply executes the raw subtraction operation without SafeMath
balanceOf reads the balances mapping

transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on the caller-supplied tokenAddress contract, a callback into external code

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only meaningful as the input that sets pending newOwner inside transferOwnership, so fold it into that function node
tokenOwner is the balance lookup key used only inside balanceOf, so fold it into that function node
to is the recipient argument used only inside transfer, so fold it into that function node
tokens is the transfer amount used only inside transfer, so fold it into that function node
spender is the allowance grantee argument used only inside approve, so fold it into that function node
tokens is the allowance amount argument used only inside approve, so fold it into that function node
from is the debited account argument used only inside transferFrom, so fold it into that function node
to is the credited account argument used only inside transferFrom, so fold it into that function node
tokens is the moved amount argument used only inside transferFrom, so fold it into that function node
tokenOwner is the allowance owner key used only inside allowance, so fold it into that function node
spender is the allowance spender key used only inside allowance, so fold it into that function node
spender is both the allowance grantee and the target of the external receiveApproval call, so fold it into the unsafe external-call node
tokens is the allowance amount argument used only inside approveAndCall, so fold it into that function node

tokenAddress is the arbitrary external contract target of the ERC20 transfer call, so fold it into the unsafe external-call node
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external contract call, so fold it into the unsafe external-call node
